caption:
The voice in your head is not a bystander. It is a dye.

Save this, and listen to your first thought tomorrow morning.

From "The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech." Link in bio.

#innerspeech #marcusaurelius #stoicism #selftalk #mindset

text: “The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.”
Marcus wrote this to himself, in a private notebook, while running an empire.
He was watching his own mind.
Most of our thoughts arrive in words.
A running commentary, quiet and constant, that we rarely question.
Repeated often enough, a sentence stops sounding like an opinion.
It starts sounding like *the truth about you.*
Not one thought, but the same thought, soaked in day after day.
The first step is not to silence the voice.
It is to *hear* it, word for word, as if someone else were speaking.
Catch one sentence you say to yourself.
Ask, *would I say this to a friend?*
Which sentence in your head has been repeating the longest?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Learn to hear the voice, then choose the words.
